Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Operation.FileOperationWithDynamicPath
Class.Description: Sets file path based on the orginal file name path passed to the operation

Property.name: UseDateFolders
Property.Description:
When set adds subfolders for current date (YYYY/MM/DD) under last folder in the path to the output folder used by this operation
Examples:
* [FilePath from settings]/2026/10/2
* [FilePath from settings]/SplitterArchive/Desert//2026/09/23

Property.name: OriginalPathParentFolder
Property.Description:
Directory name to search for in OriginalFilename
When not blank, uses this string to search for a directory in the OriginalFilename matching it and to appened that directory and all subdirectories from the OriginalFilename to the end of the FilePath set on this operation for output path

Property.name: AlterativeParentFolder
Property.Description:
Directory name to replace orginal parent folder with.
When not blank, uses this string to replace the OriginalPathParentFolder set on this operation for output path. Thus only used if OriginalPathParentFolder is also not blank.
Usefull when the destination has a diffrent parent folder or for archiving folders rather than true destination path

Example:
* Source Path: [RootPath from OriginalFilename]/SplitterInput/Desert/
* Dest Path without this set: [FilePath from settings]/SplitterInput/Desert/
* Dest Path with this set to "SplitterArchive": [FilePath from settings]/SplitterArchive/Desert/

Method.name: OnMessage
setPathFromOriginal
AddDateFolders
